focus.title: 美国拟升级对华芯片出口管制，聚焦AI算力芯片与半导体设备
focus.summary: 据多家国际媒体报道，美国商务部计划于近期进一步收紧对华半导体出口管制，重点限制用于人工智能训练的高算力芯片及先进制程设备。新规可能将更多中国科技企业列入实体清单，并扩大对第三国转口芯片的审查。此举将直接影响中国AI产业供应链，建议相关企业提前评估合规风险，调整采购与研发策略。
focus.title_en: US to Tighten Chip Export Controls Targeting AI Chips and Equipment
focus.summary_en: According to reports from international media, the US Department of Commerce plans to further tighten semiconductor export controls on China, focusing on high-performance AI training chips and advanced manufacturing equipment. The new rules may add more Chinese tech companies to the Entity List and expand scrutiny of transshipment of chips via third countries. This will directly impact China's AI supply chain. Companies are advised to assess compliance risks and adjust procurement and R&D strategies.

case.title: 香港法院承认内地判决，跨境执行再添新案例
case.summary: 香港高等法院近日就一起涉及内地公司的合同纠纷作出判决，依据《内地与香港特别行政区法院相互认可和执行民商事案件判决的安排》，承认并执行内地法院的生效判决。该案明确了香港法院在审查内地判决时对程序公正性的关注要点，为内地企业在港追讨债务提供了积极指引。实务中，建议企业注意判决的终局性及送达程序的合法性。
case.title_en: Hong Kong Court Recognizes Mainland Judgment, Adding New Precedent for Cross-border Enforcement
case.summary_en: The Hong Kong High Court recently ruled on a contract dispute involving a Mainland company, recognizing and enforcing a final judgment of a Mainland court under the Arrangement on Mutual Recognition and Enforcement of Judgments in Civil and Commercial Matters between the Mainland and Hong Kong. The case clarifies the court's focus on procedural fairness in reviewing Mainland judgments, providing positive guidance for Mainland enterprises seeking debt recovery in Hong Kong. In practice, companies should pay attention to the finality of judgments and the legality of service.
case.source_en: Source: Judiciary of Hong Kong · Aug 2026

policy.title: 广东发布支持跨境法律服务集聚区建设若干措施，鼓励涉外律师发展
policy.summary: 广东省司法厅近期出台措施，支持广州、深圳等地建设跨境法律服务集聚区，通过税收优惠、人才引进、机构补贴等方式，吸引国内外知名律所和仲裁机构入驻。同时，鼓励内地律师与港澳律师联营合作，共同为湾区企业提供跨境争议解决、合规咨询等一站式服务。此举将提升大湾区涉外法律服务能力，助力企业“走出去”。
policy.title_en: Guangdong Issues Measures to Support Cross-border Legal Service Clusters, Encouraging Foreign-related Lawyers
policy.summary_en: The Department of Justice of Guangdong Province recently issued measures to support the construction of cross-border legal service clusters in cities like Guangzhou and Shenzhen, offering tax incentives, talent introduction, and institutional subsidies to attract renowned domestic and international law firms and arbitration institutions. It also encourages partnership between Mainland and Hong Kong/Macau lawyers to jointly provide one-stop services for cross-border dispute resolution and compliance consulting for enterprises in the Greater Bay Area. This will enhance the foreign-related legal service capacity of the region and support enterprises going global.
policy.source_en: Source: Department of Justice of Guangdong Province · Aug 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟《外国补贴条例》执法趋严，中企应建专项合规机制
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：近期欧盟《外国补贴条例》已进入实质性执法阶段，针对中国企业的调查数量明显上升，涉及并购、公共采购等领域。该条例要求企业主动申报在欧盟获得的财政资助，否则面临高额罚款。建议中国出海企业建立专项合规机制，梳理欧盟及成员国政府补贴情况，在交易前进行补贴申报评估，并留存完整证据链。同时，可借助外部律师进行模拟审查，降低被调查风险。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation Enforcement Intensifies, Chinese Firms Should Build Specialized Compliance Mechanisms
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation has entered substantive enforcement phase, with a notable increase in investigations against Chinese companies in M&A and public procurement. The regulation requires proactive notification of financial contributions received from EU and member states, with heavy fines for non-compliance. Chinese enterprises going global are advised to establish specialized compliance mechanisms, map out subsidies from the EU and member states, conduct pre-transaction subsidy notification assessments, and maintain complete evidence chains. Additionally, engaging external counsel for mock reviews can reduce investigation risks.
